kind: code (tier B). Depends on 0.2 (system.transform pin), 3.2 (legalTools), 8.1 (packs). Subagents read §6.4 (1892-1906), §4.1 (1512-1543), §4.4 headers (1636-1698), §3.8 (1478-1495).
signatureNote: The §6.4 ledger arg list for buildSystemAppend omits the scalars legalTools + the state block need, so this task adds a trailing ctx object: { repoConfigured, taintCount, overridesRemaining } (§2 schema untouched; a helper-signature extension, deviation recorded in STATE). loadPacks(doctrineDir) + initPlugin({doctrineDir,logError,writeBeacon}) carry the §6.4 fail-closed init; the init-failure channel is the injected logError seam (§7.1 stderr), NOT a journal event (closed vocab has no init event).

assertions.text: buildSystemAppend(registryEntry, run, items, questions, packs, ctx) -> string[] ([0]=role pack verbatim, last=state block); paramsForRole(role) -> {temperature, topP?}; headersFor(registryEntry, job?) -> Record<string,string>
orchestrator gets core.md + run state block; implementer gets tdd.md + its item block
state block stays <=30 lines with 40 items (summarization asserted)
recommended-tool line matches legalTools(...).recommended for three run states AND names conductor_setup on an unconfigured repo
two-item wave: block names ONE recommendation, reports others as a count - never contradictory instructions
header set per role (§4.4 tags): role, priority (interactive|review|batch), group when a tree is known, schema only when the job flags it
missing pack file at init throws AND the throw is surfaced via the injected logError seam AND liveness beacon NOT written (so §3.8's absence signal is real)

REVIEW-DRIVEN (C-027, major): a null recommendation renders legalTools(...).why verbatim, never a hardcoded 'terminal' claim - legalTools returns recommended=null in NON-terminal states (stalled EXECUTING wave, INTAKE non-work, default) too, so the injected block must not assert a false terminality

REVIEW-DRIVEN (C-027, fail-closed hardening): a present-but-empty/whitespace-only pack is rejected - loadPacks/initPlugin throw naming it and the §3.8 beacon is never written (an empty pack is effectively-absent doctrine, the exact 'looks normal, enforces nothing' mode §3.8 guards)

PHASE-8-GATE-DRIVEN (C-028, major): §4.1 implementer pack is 'tdd.md (+debug.md in DEBUG)' - buildSystemAppend appends debug.md as a secondary pack (tdd.md stays primary) for an implementer whose active item has debugging:true (new optional GateItem.debugging field, ignored by legalTools); non-implementer roles / missing itemId / non-debugging items get nothing extra
